output.summary: An aquatic fern native to numerous countries across Africa and Asia, as well as Brazil, Trinidad and Tobago, and several Indian Ocean islands. It creeps and spreads in water but may form cushions on land, with adults typically growing terrestrially. It is eaten in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh, though the plant part and preparation are not specified.
